objective: Prove that at every even side n >= 2 the corner's return series in either half-strip (one far wall removed) equals the quadrant's over GF(2), and that at every odd side n >= 3 it differs, first at time 4n.
status: Obstructed 2026-11-10 (pre-registered in a5769c7a7; refereed): B1 (one far wall invisible at even sides) and B2 (seen first at 4n at odd sides) not proved; B1 at n is the identity of ticket A on the path of n - 1 vertices. Proved: the two half-strips agree, and the strip's four-periodic eigenvector exists exactly at even sides with the two-site transfer squaring to I on its branch (Proposition 6). Computed: B1 at every even side 2 to 80, B2 at every odd side 3 to 79; without the bottom wall the far wall is seen at 4n at every side tested.
title: One far wall is invisible at even sides
